Q: How do I match an element containing two matching child elements with CSS? A:

Use :has() twice to specify two different conditions.

selection:has(h2):has(.subtitle)

Source: CSS Tricks - The CSS :has Selector (and 4+ Examples)

Q: How can I make links with generic names like "Overview" in navigation structures most accessible? A:

You can give each list a name which screen reader users will hear when they first navigate into the list. Add a unique ID to the the text above the list and then use aria-labelledby on the <ul> setting it's value to the ID.
